citations.assessment: The directly matched objection is in Rav Yehudah bar Yishmael’s name. Preserve the bare heading.

The checked Yerushalmi says his foot was chafed and states a patch was fitted underneath. Penei Moshe explains this as abrasion to the sole of the foot, and Jastrow identifies the same lexical occurrence.
